explanation: Erdős #1086 asks to estimate g(n), the maximum number of equal-area (positive area) triangles determined by n points in the plane. triangleAreaCount counts 3-subsets of P with the given |area|, and g is attained since it is bounded by C(n,3). "Estimate" is posed as Θ of an unknown answer function. The site gives n² log log n ≪ g(n) ≪ n^{20/9}. The statement is faithful and open.
